corrections: Dedicated 2020 SR22T G6 composite shell, cuffed wing, swept fin, wheel fairings, 78-inch three-blade propeller and genuine windshield/door/rear-window apertures replace the generic low-wing model.

Uniform top/side/front overlays drove a narrower aft fuselage, shorter tail cone and rear windows, corrected baggage hatch placement, rounded wheel-fairing sections and revised cockpit roof clearance.

The 2020 factory photograph calibrates optional 12-inch Perspective+ displays, MD302, bolster, QWERTY/AFCS/audio console, side yokes and ventilation controls. Cabin plan and cutaway establish two front seats and a rear three-place bench. Protruding glareshield, console and sun visors were corrected after close inspection.

Side yokes translate for pitch and rotate for roll. The inclined console carries locally oriented flap control/lamps, with three detent lights driven by measured flap travel; intermediate or missing readings leave all lamps dark.

PFD and MD302 share TAS, geometric altitude and independent pitch/bank. MFD propeller readout is scaled to the documented 2500 RPM. Imported GLB tests verify controls, missing sensors, window sightlines and units; nine shared aircraft instrument tests passed.
reviewNotes.visual: Individually inspected final side/top/front/panel overlays, all four turntables, three-quarter, operator, cabin and wide cabin. Inspected zero, 180-knot/12500-foot/2400-RPM cruise, 2500-RPM upper-range and unavailable TAS/RPM/flap cases, plus passenger and close exterior views. Compared actual 2020 factory cockpit/cabin photographs and G6 exterior photograph; no reference was stretched.
limitations: The POH drawing is not dimensionally consistent: at uniform length scale, side height is about 2.92 m rather than printed 2.713 m; front-view wheel track is about 3.15 m versus printed 2.774 m. Main-wheel fore/aft placement differs by roughly 0.3 m between side and plan projections. Printed dimensions and planform take precedence, leaving visible overlay residuals.

Windshield/cowling/roof curvature, wing-root fillets, door corners, dorsal fin and wheel fairing transitions remain polygonal approximations; small side-view contour and height residuals remain. Shell detail follows composite construction, with fasteners at service panels and metal control surfaces rather than an invented all-metal rivet grid.

Photo scale assumes a 12-inch 4:3 active display; exact bezel dimensions and panel depth were not independently measured. Curved bolster, seat bolsters, switches, fine legends, circuit breakers and console depth are simplified. The CC BY-SA cockpit photograph documents older Perspective equipment only, not G6 controls; exact 2020 factory photography remains local study only. No reference pixels are shipped.

Live instruments show TAS, geometric world elevation, true heading and normalized simulated shaft RPM. IAS/pressure altitude, magnetic errors, manifold pressure, power percentage, thermal/oil/fuel/electrical/ice systems, propeller governing and detailed engine management are not simulated. Unsupported fields remain blank or INOP; moving PFD/MD302 displays are a subset of the real avionics.

FMS, AFCS, navigation, synthetic vision, radio controls, mixture and CAPS activation are not interactive. Pilot flap input currently selects up/down, although the geometry can display intermediate state and 50-percent annunciation. Flight tuning is an assisted simulation rather than a validated aircraft performance model.

controlReview.checks: Imported GLB control-point movement tested at positive and negative commands; all 20 aircraft pass. Cockpit pairs and all ten airplane exterior pairs visually inspected. Roll, pitch, rudder and declared pedal directions corrected; ailerons and full flap deployment corrected.
limitations: Checks cover existing bindings; Cherokee and Caravan pedal geometry is static.
Full control travel and flight response remain approximations unless independently dimensioned in the model reference notes.
This audit verifies movement; it does not upgrade legacy helicopter avionics or remove previously documented geometry limitations.
